findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed Cl- sanitizer solution to test at 0 ppm Cl-. Solution was remade and tested at 200 ppm Cl-.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Styrofoam containers on the outside table are stored with the food contact surfaces facing up/ exposed. The items were flipped over to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114 Bleach solutions in sani-bucket & 3pt sink were at 0-10ppm. Solutions were remade at 100-200ppm. Ensure solutions are checked frequently & changed as needed. Maintain bleach solutions at 100-200ppm.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Hotdogs stuck for use to make corndogs were at 49F-52F. Hotdogs were prepped ~2hrs prior. Hotdogs will be used or discarded by end of operations. 
Fridge was holding around ~45F. Monitor the temperature & move TCS foods to other cold holding units if fridge is unable to maintain foods at 41F/below.
Spot check will be conducted tomorrow to verify proper function.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11 - Pork cooked at home & cooled. Reheated here today. BBQ sandwich taken off of the menu and will not be served here today. Manager will get a pre cooked product form Humphrey;s before serving tomorrow. Cold pork will be taken home and hot BBQ will be discarded when it cools down (or eaten by owner) Cooland and reheating is outside of the scope of permit allowances.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14 Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation (C)

Observed in-use wiping rag to not be immersed in sanitizer bucket. Discussed practice with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration and Hardness (P) 

Observed bleach in 3 compartment sink to be low - 50 ppm. Corrected to 100 ppm. PIC has appropriate test strips. COS.
